newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil futures end down on liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil futures end down on liquidation.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jul (3rd pos) 1,257 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,340 *
Open/hi/low 1,278/1,279/1,256 Prev close 1,345
Prev settlement 1,275 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices reversed an early trend and closed lower on profit-taking. Players also liquidated positions as refiners' buying in the physical market dried up. Higher soyoil futures overnight and news of delayed shipments of Indonesian crude palm oil supported earlier prices.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Crude palm oil prices fell back after recent gains on the back of refiners' covering.
Traders pegged immediate support for the contract at 1,250 ringgit, while resistance remains at 1,280.

A firmer Chicago soyoil futures close overnight and news that Indonesia's state-run Joint Marketing Board has delayed export shipments of about 20,000 tonnes of crude palm oil supported earlier prices, traders said.
They said strong exports for April could also limit the market's downside in the near term.
Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) on Monday estimated exports for April 1-20 at 429,661 tonnes, against 391,599 tonnes in March 1-20.
Volume on the futures market stood at 2,254 lots against 2,220 lots on Monday.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,340 ringgit ($535.36) a tonne with bids at 1,337.500, after trading from 1,347.50 to 1,337.50.
April (central) was offered at 1,315 with bids at 1,310, and traded from 1,320 to 1,315.
April (north) saw offers at 1,295 and bids at 1,287.50.
May (south) was offered at 1,340 ringgit with bids at 1,337.50. It was traded from 1,347.50 to 1,340.
May (central) saw offers at 1,310 and bids at 1,300.
Among refined products, May RBD palm olein was offered at $595 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Jun at $585, Jul at $577.50 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $572.50. May was traded at $595.
May RBD palm oil was offered at $555, Jun at $550 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $545.
May RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $435 and Jun at $427.50.
May/Jun palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $290.
